mapper.select: SELECT id, title, template, style, content, updated_at FROM resume WHERE user_id = #{owner} AND deleted = FALSE ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id ASC
SELECT id, title, template, style, content, updated_at FROM resume WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{owner} AND deleted = FALSE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO resume (id, user_id, title, template, style, content) VALUES (#{id}, #{owner}, #{write.title}, #{write.template}, #{write.style,typeHandler=com.resumecraft.common.JsonbTypeHandler}, #{write.content,typeHandler=com.resumecraft.common.JsonbTypeHandler})
mapper.update: UPDATE resume SET title = #{write.title}, template = #{write.template}, style = #{write.style,typeHandler=com.resumecraft.common.JsonbTypeHandler}, content = #{write.content,typeHandler=com.resumecraft.common.JsonbTypeHandler}, updated_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{owner} AND deleted = FALSE
UPDATE resume SET title = #{title}, updated_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{owner} AND deleted = FALSE
UPDATE resume SET deleted = TRUE, updated_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{owner} AND deleted = FALSE
